season.evidence: Stored Jul-Sep kept. Logged successful ascents: Jun 5, Jul 18, Aug 18, Sep 9, Oct 4; WebSearch: peak page lists spring/summer/fall with no permit, glacier-area approach hikes snowy early; the Jul 2 report still found lots of snow between White Pass and the peak.

track.why: Only one route stored on this peak. Complete round trip July 2 2024 logged 'White Pass': starts/ends 48 and 62 m from our North Fork Sauk pin, follows the PCT to White Pass and south, leaves the trail near Indian Pass and climbs the west/southwest slopes to the summit (high point 2 m from Peakbagger summit), descends the NW snow. Matches our described line. Early July but in July season.

pins.name: Indian Head Peak summit
pins.evidence: The route stores only a trailhead pin; the Peakbagger surveyed summit coordinate matches the highest point of three independent tracks within 2-4 m (the other three within 36 m).
pins.confirmedBy: Peakbagger surveyed coordinate 48.007925, -121.098305 (lidar elevation 7447.4 ft) from the packet's peakbagger record

facts.text: Maps show a ridge boot path that is not really there; expect to pick your own line over grass and talus by sight.
The short class 3 step on the east summit can be skipped by circling around it.
The peak itself is dry in August; refill at the spring-fed stream just south of White Pass on the PCT.
In late September one party found descending the southeast col and granite shelves easier than the airy west ridge: class 2 with a few easy class 3 moves.

notes: Route has no Summit pin stored; proposed add from Peakbagger plus track highs. Peak has twin summits (west 7436 ft, east 7447 ft); tracks reach both.
